title: When the Radiators Breaks
author: R. M. Yarrow
blurb: Ulyana Blackwood, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
